subject: Clarion: real-time triage — deployment path & next steps
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwo od.com>
To: David Liu <david.liu@clarionhealth.com>, Maya Chen <maya.chen@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Clarion: real-time triage — deployment path & next steps

Hi David / Maya —

Thanks again for the deep dive this morning. Quick recap while things are fresh and a proposed set of next steps so we can converge on Hosted vs Dedicated for the triage assistant workload.

Key signals from the call:
- Peak load: ~150 QPS for inference spikes during business hours; baseline ~30 QPS.
- Latency target: 95th < 50ms, 99th < 120ms for short-context recommendations (<=256 tokens).
- Throughput pattern: sustained bursts (5–10 minute windows) plus occasional large batch re-ranking jobs overnight.
- Data controls: PHI is limited to pseudonymized context today; Clarion prefers VPC options long-term but is open to hosted if encryption + audit logging meet requirements.

Questions we flagged that will determine pathing:
1) Can Redwood meet the 99th-ms SPL for the conversational workload on Hosted with our latency-optimized model variants, or will Dedicated capacity be required for consistent 99th performance?
2) For Dedicated, what GPU pool sizing (instances / reserved capacity) do we recommend for 150 QPS peaks while preserving tail latency targets?
3) What does the pilot look like (length, SLA, traffic split, price estimate) for a quick production validation?

Proposed next steps (my ask):
- We’ll run a focused latency benchmark using Clarion’s sample harness (if you can share a small representative load file) against our Hosted latency profile and report P50/P95/P99 with and without batching.
- If Hosted doesn’t meet the 99th target at peak, propose a Dedicated pilot sizing and cost range for 30/150 QPS scenarios.
- Share formal SLO doc and Clarion security questionnaire (procurement) — I’ve cc’d Laura to help with that pack.

Can you drop the SLO and a 5–10 minute anonymized sample trace to the Drive folder below? I’ll schedule the benchmark and aim to return numbers within 48 business hours.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ClarionPilot
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4832

Thanks — talk soon.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Clarion: real-time triage — deployment path & next steps

Thanks Stephanie — appreciate the quick recap.

Attaching our SLO matrix and a small anonymized sample payload set (see clarion_slo_requirements.pdf and clarion_latency_sample_logs.zip). A couple clarifications:
- The 99th requirement is strict during peak windows; we can tolerate slightly higher P50 for cost reasons but not the tail.
- For data controls: initial pilot can be hosted as long as audit logs and per-request encryption keys are available; if we move to production we expect VPC/private deployment options within 6–12 months.

We’re comfortable with Redwood running the latency harness against Hosted first. If results show unacceptable tail risk, we’ll want a Dedicated sizing + price range.

Can you also confirm whether Redwood’s Hosted offering supports prefix/KV caching for repeated context across requests? That could materially improve tail latency for our workload.

Thanks —
David
David Liu
Director, Applied AI | Clarion Health
David.Liu@clarionhealth.com

Attachment: clarion_latency_sample_logs.zip (zip)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Clarion: real-time triage — deployment path & next steps

Fyi — Clarion sent SLOs and a sample harness. Short internal note / ask:

Summary of ask:
- They want Hosted first. Requirement: P99 < 120ms at 150 QPS peaks. Context <=256 tokens.
- They explicitly asked if Hosted supports prefix/KV caching — we should confirm behavior and whether it's enabled in Hosted by default or needs config.

My take / proposed pilot config:
- Run 48h benchmark against Hosted latency-optimized model (redwood-rt-1) with:
  - no-batching and small-batch (batch size 8) runs to show delta
  - KV/prefix caching enabled and disabled to measure tail impact
- If Hosted P99 is >120ms at peak: propose Dedicated pilot with reserved pool sized for 150 QPS peak. Suggest initial Dedicated pool: 4 x A100-equivalent instances with continuous batching disabled for low tail — we can refine after benchmark.
- Pricing: provide a banded estimate (monthly reserved range + pilot hourly test rate) — Rishi, can you provide a quick ballpark so we can include numbers in the reply?

Operational asks: Laura, please prep an export with Hosted audit log sample + statement of encryption in transit & at rest. I’ll offer to run the benchmark once we confirm the harness drop.

—Stephanie

Subject: Re: Clarion: real-time triage — deployment path & next steps

Hi David —

Thanks for the artifacts — we reviewed the SLO doc and it’s clear. Next concrete actions from our side:

1) Latency benchmark: we’ll run your sample harness against Hosted (redwood-rt-1). We’ll perform four runs: cold/no-cache, cached-prefix, small-batch (bs=8), and small-batch+cache. Expect P50/P95/P99 tables and per-run traces. Target delivery: EOD Wednesday (2026-12-03) in the Drive folder you shared.

2) Dedicated sizing fallback: if Hosted P99 > 120ms at peak, we propose a Dedicated pilot baseline of 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs (reserved pilot pool) — this is a conservative starting point to hit tail targets; we’ll run the same harness on that pool to show improvement. I’ll include an estimated monthly reserved cost band in the pilot MR.

3) Hosted capabilities: prefix/KV caching is available in Hosted and can be enabled per route. I’ll document default behavior and toggles in the pilot note.

4) Procurement/security: Laura will upload Hosted audit-log samples, encryption statement, and a short SOC2 excerpt by EOD tomorrow. Procurement, cc’d, please confirm if you need any additional artifacts (formal AICPA letter, penetration test reports, etc.).

Action items for Clarion: please confirm the exact 10–minute peak distribution you want us to emulate (we’ll use your sample trace by default but confirm if there are heavier microbursts). Also confirm whether we should route pilot traffic through your VPC peering in parallel — that will impact test topology/time.

If that plan looks good I’ll schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow to kick off and put the pilot MR in HubSpot.

Thanks —
—Stephanie
